paper.title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still struggle on tasks requiring complex visual understanding. We argue that the core issue is not high-level reasoning, but instead failing to locate critical details in the image. Due to this shortcoming, VLMs generate often plausible but incorrect reasoning based on flawed perceptual grounding. To address this, we propose Locator-Critic (LOCI), a training-free framework that decouples visual search from evidence verification. LOCI employs a Locator agent to prop

summary.core_problem: VLM 在复杂视觉问答中常因找不到关键视觉证据而推理失真，论文试图用训练外的定位-批判闭环修正这一问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 inference-time agentic scaffolding，而不是预训练本身。它有一点启发：复杂多模态错误未必来自高层推理，而可能来自感知 grounding 失败，这对原生多模态预训练目标设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LOCI 框架，将视觉搜索与证据验证解耦：Locator 负责提出候选视觉证据，Critic 评估其相关性与充分性，两者通过 refinement loop 迭代，直到证据足以支持回答。整体是 training-free 的测试时方法。
summary.experiments: 在多个复杂视觉 benchmark 上评测，报告对开源模型如 Qwen3-VL 在 V*、HR-Bench 等上有明显增益，也对闭源模型如 Gemini 2.5 Pro 有提升。论文强调 gains 来自更好的 evidence grounding，而非额外训练或更强解码器。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Mathilde Caron、Arsha Nagrani、Cordelia Schmid，均与视觉表征和多模态研究相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that VLM failures on complex visual tasks often come from missing critical visual evidence rather than weak high-level reasoning, and proposes a test-time loop to fix that.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time agentic method rather than a pretraining paper. Its main value for pretraining researchers is the diagnosis: many multimodal reasoning errors may actually be grounding failures, which matters for native multimodal objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOCI decouples visual search from evidence verification. A Locator proposes candidate evidence, a Critic checks relevance and sufficiency, and the two interact in an iterative refinement loop until the evidence is adequate for answering. The framework is training-free.
summary_en.experiments: It reports substantial gains on multiple challenging visual benchmarks, including improvements for open models such as Qwen3-VL on V* and HR-Bench, and gains for closed models like Gemini 2.5 Pro. The paper attributes the gains to better perceptual grounding rather than extra training.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Mathilde Caron, Arsha Nagrani, and Cordelia Schmid, all well known in visual representation and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“推理错”拆成“先没看对”，这个诊断值得记；只看方法图和误差分析就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the diagnosis is useful: many VLM reasoning failures are really perception failures; read the method figure and error analysis, then move on.

paper.title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (i.e. images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning thr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的不是单一模型结构，而是一个更上游的问题：如果把“视觉生成过程本身”当作推理载体，而不是把图像/视频只当输入输出，那么这个方向缺少可规模化训练任务、可靠反馈信号，以及不同生成 substrate 之间的可控比较框架。作者想解决的是 native visual reasoning 研究里的基础设施缺口。全文围绕三个痛点展开：第一，现有 benchmark 多半只适合评测，不适合持续训练；第二，VLM-as-a-judge 在细粒度视觉规则判断上不够可靠，难以作为优化信号；第三，图像生成、视频生成、图文交错生成到底哪种更适合承载视觉推理，过去缺少同分布、同任务、同反馈下的公平比较。
summary.importance: 对纯文本 LLM 预训练的直接影响不大，但对多模态预训练、可验证奖励、以及“非语言 substrate 上的推理训练”有中等启发。它的重要性主要体现在两点。其一，它把 native visual reasoning 从零散 benchmark 变成了一个闭环训练环境：任务可程序化生成，输出可验证打分，奖励可直接用于 RL，且不同生成形式可以在同一任务分布下比较。这种设计思路与基座模型研究里越来越重视的 verifiable reward、synthetic curriculum、closed-loop optimization 是一致的。其二，论文强调 instance-level reward fidelity，而不是只看模型级 rank correlation，这一点对后训练和可验证优化很有借鉴意义。若把视角放宽到 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口，这篇工作更像是在为“生成式推理能力如何被稳定训练出来”提供实验平台，而不是直接提出新的预训练 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: VBVR-Pro 的核心是一个闭环 suite，而不是单个模型。方法上有三层。第一层是任务生成。作者构建了 300 个 procedural tasks，每个任务都能随机化参数，自动生成训练样本，并同时导出多种对齐模态：视频、关键帧图像、以及带文本注释的 interleaved 表示。这样做的目的不是单纯扩数据，而是保证 image generator、video generator、interleaved generator 在同一底层任务分布上训练和比较，减少数据分布差异带来的结论污染。第二层是可验证反馈。作者没有依赖通用 MLLM judge，而是为任务配套 structured semantic extraction 和 task-grounded verification scorer。也就是说，模型生成的视觉轨迹先被解析成结构化语义，再根据任务规则做程序化核验，得到可用于评测和 RL 的 reward。全文特别强调，这类 scorer 的质量不是用 aggregate correlation 粗略验证，而是通过 arena-style human study 在单样本层面检查与人工判断的一致性。第三层是优化与 substrate 比较。基于这些 verifiable rewards，作者对多任务 visual reasoning 做强化学习，并在 image、video、interleaved 三类生成 substrate 上做受控实验，分析不同视觉推理载体的效率、表达能力和泛化差异。论文还加入了若干诊断分析，例如最近邻检索和 same-prompt visual counterfactual，用来排除“只是记住指令模板”这种解释。
summary.experiments: 实验部分的主结论有三类。第一类是 transfer。作者声称，基于 VBVR-Pro 训练的模型在七个外部视觉推理 benchmark 上都有稳定收益，很多设置下提升超过 20 个百分点。文中点名的外部评测包括 RISE-Video、V-ReasonBench、RULER-Bench、MME-CoF-Pro、VideoThinkBench、BabyVision 和 IntelligentVBench。作者据此主张，任务机制覆盖面的广度比在少数任务上单纯堆更多样本更重要。第二类是 reward quality。论文系统分析了 GPT-5.5、Qwen-3.7-plus、Gemini-3.1-Pro 等 MLLM 作为 judge 的失败模式，包括数值不精确、忽略细粒度证据、误解规则等；与之相比，任务定制的 verifier 在 instance-level arena 人评中与人工更一致，并且能提供方向明确的学习信号。第三类是 optimization。使用这些 verifiable rewards 做多任务 RL 时，即便在较强 baseline 上也能持续提升，说明 reward 不只是“能打分”，而是真的“能训练”。此外，论文还做了数据泄漏和模式拟合层面的诊断：最近邻分析显示外部 benchmark 样本并不能由训练集近邻解释；same-prompt counterfactual 表明模型会随视觉状态变化而改变输出，而不是只跟着文字提示走。由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格，无法在这里逐项复述所有模型规模和绝对分数，但从作者叙述看，实验重点不是单一模型刷榜，而是证明 suite 作为训练基础设施是可扩展、可验证、可优化的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓住它不是方法论文意义上的“新模型”，而是训练与评测基础设施。建议先看 Introduction 里三条主线：task scaling、verifiable reward、substrate comparison。然后看任务构造部分，确认 300 个 procedural tasks 如何同时生成 image/video/interleaved 数据，以及为什么这种 aligned generation 对公平比较重要。接着重点看 reward 设计与 judge 分析，这是全文最有借鉴意义的部分，尤其是 instance-level human study 的协议和 verifier 的构造方式。之后再看 transfer 和 RL 优化结果，判断这些奖励是否真的能支撑学习，而不只是离线评测。若时间有限，优先读任务设计、reward verification、外部 benchmark transfer 三部分，40 分钟左右可以建立完整印象；若要深挖，值得仔细看 counterfactual 和 nearest-neighbor 诊断，因为它们直接关系到“学到的是推理操作还是模板匹配”这个关键问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an infrastructure gap rather than a single-model problem. If visual generation itself is treated as the medium of reasoning, instead of using images or videos only as inputs and outputs around a language reasoner, then the field lacks scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. The authors frame native visual reasoning as being bottlenecked by three missing pieces: trainable task sources rather than evaluation-only benchmarks, reward signals that are precise enough for optimization rather than loose VLM judging, and a common task distribution that allows image, video, and interleaved generation to be compared fairly.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to text-only LLM pretraining is limited, but it is meaningfully relevant to multimodal pretraining, verifiable rewards, and non-language reasoning substrates. The main value is that it turns native visual reasoning into a closed-loop setup: tasks are procedurally generated, outputs are verifiably scored, rewards can be used for RL, and different generative substrates can be studied under matched conditions. That design is aligned with broader trends in foundation-model research, where synthetic curricula, verifier-based optimization, and closed-loop training environments are becoming more important. Another useful contribution is the emphasis on instance-level reward fidelity rather than model-level rank correlation. That point transfers well to post-training and verifier design more generally. So the paper is less about a new pretraining recipe and more about building an experimental platform for training generative reasoning capabilities in a stable way.
summary_en.technical_approach: VBVR-Pro is a suite, not a single architecture. Its method has three main layers. First, task generation: the authors build 300 procedural tasks with randomized parameters, allowing scalable sample generation. Each task emits aligned outputs in multiple modalities, including videos, keyframe images, and interleaved text-visual representations. This is important because it lets image generators, video generators, and interleaved generators be trained and compared on the same underlying task distribution rather than on loosely matched datasets. Second, verifiable feedback: instead of relying on generic MLLM judges, the suite pairs tasks with structured semantic extraction and task-grounded verification scorers. Generated visual trajectories are parsed into structured semantics and then checked against task rules programmatically, producing rewards that can be used both for evaluation and reinforcement learning. The paper stresses that reward quality is validated at the instance level through arena-style human studies, not just through aggregate correlations. Third, optimization and substrate comparison: with these verifiable rewards, the authors run multi-task RL for visual reasoning and compare image, video, and interleaved generative substrates under controlled conditions. They also include diagnostics such as nearest-neighbor analysis and same-prompt visual counterfactuals to test whether gains come from reusable reasoning operations rather than instruction-template fitting.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story has three main parts. First is transfer. Models trained on VBVR-Pro reportedly gain consistently on seven external visual reasoning benchmarks, often by more than 20 percentage points. The named benchmarks include RISE-Video, V-ReasonBench, RULER-Bench, MME-CoF-Pro, VideoThinkBench, BabyVision, and IntelligentVBench. The authors use this to argue that broad coverage of reasoning mechanisms matters more than simply scaling the number of examples from a narrow task family. Second is reward quality. The paper analyzes failure modes of strong MLLM judges such as GPT-5.5, Qwen-3.7-plus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, highlighting numerical imprecision, missed fine-grained evidence, and rule misunderstanding. In contrast, the task-grounded verifiers show stronger agreement with human judgments in instance-level arena studies and provide cleaner learning signals. Third is optimization. When these verifiable rewards are used for multi-task RL, performance improves steadily even from strong baselines, suggesting that the rewards are useful for training rather than only for offline scoring. The paper also includes anti-shortcut diagnostics: nearest-neighbor analysis suggests that external benchmark gains are not explained by close training-set matches, and same-prompt counterfactuals show sensitivity to changes in visual state rather than just textual prompts. The provided full-text excerpt does not include all detailed tables, so I cannot reproduce every model size and absolute score here, but the experimental emphasis is clearly on validating the suite as scalable, verifiable, and optimizable infrastructure.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as an infrastructure paper, not as a new-model paper. Start with the introduction and keep the three threads in mind: task scaling, verifiable rewards, and substrate comparison. Then move to the task-construction section to understand how the 300 procedural tasks generate aligned image, video, and interleaved data, and why that alignment matters for fair comparison. After that, focus on the reward-design and judge-analysis sections. Those are the most transferable parts, especially the instance-level human evaluation protocol and the construction of the verifiers. Then read the transfer and RL sections to check whether the rewards actually support learning rather than just evaluation. If time is limited, prioritize task design, reward verification, and external transfer results; about 40 minutes should be enough for a solid pass. For deeper reading, the counterfactual and nearest-neighbor diagnostics are worth attention because they directly address whether the models learned reasoning operations or only matched superficial templates.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 reasoning 不再只靠 text token，这篇值得看任务生成和 verifier 设计；先读 task taxonomy 与 reward 章节，模型结果反而次要。
recommendation.en: If you care about reasoning beyond text tokens, read this for the task generation and verifier design; the model numbers are secondary.

paper.title: Beyond What Meets the Eye: Unveiling Situational Illusions for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Real-world situation appearances can deviate from their underlying physical states, challenging the reliability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in practical applications. In this paper, we term this phenomenon situational illusions and investigate: (1) how MLLMs perform under such illusions, and (2) how to mitigate the limitations. We first develop a comprehensive where-what-how taxonomy that characterizes where situational illusions occur, what targets they take, and how they arise.

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在面对“情境错觉”（Situational Illusions，即视觉表象与底层物理状态不一致的自然场景）时，能否准确理解并做出可靠决策？
summary.importance: 揭示了 MLLM 在真实物理世界感知中的一个关键盲区。与以往关注人为设计的视觉错觉（如几何错觉、对抗样本）不同，本文关注的是自然场景中因遮挡、视角或光影导致的物理状态误判。这对于具身智能和机器人的可靠部署至关重要，属于 VLM 预训练和对齐阶段需要重点关注的鲁棒性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 构建了情境错觉的细粒度分类体系（Where-What-How），涵盖 4 种场景、12 种误判目标和 5 种形成机制。2) 提出了 MSIBench 评测基准，包含 3,723 个图文对，用于评估 MLLM 的错觉辨别、理解和推理能力。3) 探索了缓解策略，包括针对闭源模型的 Prompting 方法和针对开源模型的监督微调（SFT），引导模型关注视觉证据以更准确地解释情境错觉。
summary.experiments: 评估了 27 种模型配置，发现当前 MLLM 极易受情境错觉影响，整体平均准确率低于 63%，在动作规划任务上甚至低于 45%。通过 Prompting 和 SFT 缓解策略，使用有限数据可将模型性能提升高达 20%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Taxonomy 部分对情境错觉的分类（Property, Relation, Context），以及 MSIBench 的构建逻辑。实验部分可快速浏览各模型在不同错觉类型下的表现差异，重点看 SFT 缓解策略的有效性及局限性。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Can Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) accurately understand and make reliable decisions when faced with 'situational illusions' (natural scenes where visual appearance deviates from the underlying physical state)?
summary_en.importance: Exposes a critical blind spot in MLLMs' perception of the real physical world. Unlike previous work focusing on artificially designed visual illusions (e.g., geometric illusions, adversarial examples), this paper addresses misjudgments of physical states caused by occlusion, perspective, or lighting in natural scenes. This is crucial for the reliable deployment of embodied AI and robotics, and represents a robustness issue that needs significant attention during VLM pre-training and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Develops a fine-grained taxonomy of situational illusions (Where-What-How), covering 4 scenarios, 12 misperceived targets, and 5 formation mechanisms. 2) Introduces MSIBench, a benchmark with 3,723 image-text pairs, to evaluate MLLMs' illusion discrimination, understanding, and reasoning capabilities. 3) Explores mitigation strategies, including prompting for closed-source models and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for open-source models, guiding models to attend to visual evidence for more accurate interpretation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 27 model configurations, revealing that current MLLMs are highly vulnerable to situational illusions, with an overall average accuracy below 63%, dropping below 45% for action planning. Mitigation strategies (Prompting and SFT) improved model performance by up to 20% using limited data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Taxonomy section for the classification of situational illusions (Property, Relation, Context) and the construction logic of MSIBench. Briefly review the experimental results to see the performance differences across models and illusion types, paying special attention to the effectiveness and limitations of the SFT mitigation strategy. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态预训练可 skim：重点看 taxonomy 和 6 类 failure mode，数据构造比排名更有用。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for multimodal pretraining; focus on the taxonomy and six failure modes rather than the leaderboard numbers.

paper.title: Think with Structured Grounding: Perceptual Reinforcement Learning for Chart and Visual-Tabular Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) capable of thinking with images often rely on external tools for fine-grained perception. However, this reliance introduces significant inference latency and fails to effectively resolve the spatial-structural gap-a fundamental challenge in text-dense and structurally relational visuals (e.g., charts and visual tables) where strict relative spatial arrangements bind textual elements. Without external tools, standard MLLMs struggle with such fine-grained v

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在处理图表等结构化视觉数据时，依赖外部工具（如动态裁剪）进行细粒度感知会导致推理延迟高、token 爆炸，且自然语言难以精准锚定密集空间布局，容易产生“空间幻觉”。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将外部工具调用能力内化到模型参数中的新范式，避免了推理阶段的工具依赖，显著降低了延迟，并为复杂视觉推理任务提供了一种基于过程奖励的强化学习优化方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Think with Structured Grounding (TwSG) 框架。首先，利用教师模型和外部工具生成包含多轮“思考-观察”的结构化轨迹（iMCoT）。然后，通过数据蒸馏将这些轨迹内化到学生模型中，使其能在单次前向传播中完成推理。最后，引入 TL-GRPO 强化学习算法，采用标签级重要性采样（TL-IS）解决不同功能标签长度差异导致的梯度偏差问题，并结合裁剪组采样（CGS）和交错可验证奖励机制稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 在图表和视觉表格问答任务上，TwSG 相比依赖外部工具的 SOTA 方法，在显著降低推理延迟的同时，提升了推理准确性和鲁棒性。TL-GRPO 有效缓解了长度引起的梯度偏差，促进了多步推理能力的涌现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 TwSG 框架的四个阶段，特别是结构化 iMCoT 轨迹的生成方式。深入理解 TL-GRPO 算法中标签级重要性采样（TL-IS）的设计动机和实现细节，这对于解决长序列强化学习中的梯度偏差问题有启发意义。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) relying on external tools for fine-grained perception in structured visual data (e.g., charts) suffer from high inference latency, token explosion, and 'spatial hallucinations' due to the difficulty of anchoring natural language to dense spatial layouts.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel paradigm that internalizes external tool capabilities into model parameters, eliminating tool dependency during inference, significantly reducing latency, and providing a process-reward-driven reinforcement learning approach for complex visual reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Think with Structured Grounding (TwSG) framework. It first uses a teacher model and tools to generate structured trajectories (iMCoT) containing multi-turn 'think-observe' steps. These trajectories are distilled into a student model for single-pass reasoning. Finally, it introduces the TL-GRPO reinforcement learning algorithm, utilizing Tag-level Importance Sampling (TL-IS) to address gradient bias caused by varying tag lengths, combined with Clipped Group Sampling (CGS) and an interleaved verifiable reward mechanism to stabilize training.
summary_en.experiments: On chart and visual-tabular QA tasks, TwSG significantly improves reasoning accuracy and robustness while drastically reducing inference latency compared to tool-dependent SOTA methods. TL-GRPO effectively mitigates length-induced gradient bias and encourages multi-step reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the four stages of the TwSG framework, especially the generation of structured iMCoT trajectories. Deeply understand the motivation and implementation of Tag-level Importance Sampling (TL-IS) in the TL-GRPO algorithm, which is insightful for addressing gradient bias in long-sequence reinforcement learning.

recommendation.zh: 将视觉 tool-use（如 crop）能力蒸馏进 VLM 单次前向传播的思路很有趣，关注其 RL 构造 grounding 数据的具体 recipe。
recommendation.en: The idea of distilling visual tool-use (e.g., cropping) into a single VLM forward pass is interesting; pay attention to the specific RL recipe for constructing grounding data.

paper.title: VGI-BENCH: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
paper.abstract: Recent studies suggest that video generation models can exhibit certain forms of zero-shot visual reasoning through generated frames. Yet reliable evaluation remains challenging: benchmarks should adopt inputs aligned with the visual priors of current video models, require valid evolving processes rather than only plausible final states, and calibrate task difficulty to remain challenging yet partly feasible. To this end, we introduce VGI-bench, containing 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized b

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评估视频生成模型视觉智能的 benchmark，重点测试生成过程是否符合视觉推理和动态演化，而不是只看最终帧是否看起来合理。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产贡献。VGI-BENCH 把视频生成模型从画质、提示词对齐，推进到生成式视觉推理评估；对多模态基础模型研究有参考意义，尤其是判断视频生成模型是否学到了可泛化的物理和空间过程。
summary.technical_approach: Benchmark 包含 27 个任务、810 个实例，并采用两级 taxonomy：上层按任务领域组织，下层用 skill tags 做细粒度能力标注。设计原则包括输入形式贴近当前视频模型视觉先验、要求过程演化有效、并校准难度以避免过易或完全不可解。
summary.experiments: 论文评估了当前生成系统。摘要报告最强模型 Seedance 2.0 在其评测标准下仅达到 51.0%。分析还覆盖输出失败模式、输入条件敏感性，以及从静态或短程能力迁移到更复杂过程推理的边界；完整模型列表和打分协议需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The work introduces a benchmark for probing visual intelligence in video generation models, focusing on whether generated temporal processes are valid rather than whether the final state merely looks plausible.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution. VGI-BENCH moves video generation assessment beyond visual quality and prompt alignment toward generated-process reasoning, which is relevant for multimodal foundation model evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized by a two-level taxonomy of task domains and skill tags. The design aligns inputs with the visual priors of current video models, requires valid evolving processes, and calibrates task difficulty to remain challenging but partially solvable.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current generative systems. The abstract reports that the strongest model, Seedance 2.0, reaches only 51.0% under the proposed criteria. The analysis also studies failure modes, input-condition sensitivity, and the transfer boundary of visual reasoning capabilities; full model coverage and scoring details require the main text.

recommendation.zh: 作为视频生成评测资产备查即可；51% 的上限信号有用，但 810 例规模不足以支撑强结论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a video-generation evaluation reference; the 51% ceiling is informative, but 810 cases are too small for strong claims.

paper.title: Why Vision Fails as a Universal Bridge: Rectifying Modality Asynchrony in Multilingual MLLMs
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit substantial performance degradation in non-English visual reasoning, despite the strong multilingual competence of their text-only backbones. While mechanistic evidence from text-only models suggests that non-English inputs are routed through an English-centric latent space, the multimodal implications of this phenomenon remain unexplored. Through rigorous mechanistic analysis, we identify the \textbf{Ghost Anchor} phenomenon: a temporal modality

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解释并修正多语言 MLLM 在非英语视觉推理上明显掉点的问题，尤其是文本骨干本身具备多语言能力时，为什么一接入视觉就退化。
summary.importance: 价值在于它不是把问题归因于“训练数据不够”这种泛化说法，而是提出了一个可操作的机制性解释：语言侧较早完成向英语语义流形的映射，而视觉侧语义化更慢，导致早期跨模态对齐窗口里图像信号“在场但不可用”。这属于多模态预训练中的对齐时序问题，对做 native multimodal 或跨语种 MLLM 的人有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Ghost Anchor 现象，并据此设计 ANCHOR 训练框架，核心是 Proactive Visual Anchoring（PVA）：在更早层次推动视觉表征形成可用语义，使视觉信号能在语言翻译到英语中心语义空间之前参与对齐。方法重点不在新架构，而在训练时序干预和机制驱动的对齐修正。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整模型规模和数据规模，但声称通过机制分析验证了模态异步，并在多语言视觉推理上取得改进。可预期实验会包含非英语视觉问答/推理任务、与标准 MLLM 训练方式对比，以及层级表征分析来支撑“早期视觉语义不足”的判断。是否足够可信，取决于干预实验是否真正隔离了语言翻译路径与视觉成熟度两个因素。
summary.authors_note: 机构来自香港中文大学与深圳 Loop Area Institute。作者名单里暂无可直接确认的业界广为人知代表性作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why multilingual MLLMs underperform on non-English visual reasoning even when their text-only backbones are already multilingual.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a mechanistic diagnosis rather than a vague data-deficit story: language tokens are mapped into an English-centric semantic manifold early, while visual representations become semantically usable later, so the image is present but functionally ignored during the critical early alignment window. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining and multilingual MLLM design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Ghost Anchor phenomenon and propose ANCHOR, a training framework built around Proactive Visual Anchoring (PVA). The goal is to accelerate early visual semantic emergence so that visual signals can shape multilingual language processing before the language stream collapses into an English-centric latent space.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full model or data scale details, but it claims mechanistic evidence for modality asynchrony and downstream gains on multilingual visual reasoning. The key evidence likely combines intervention-style representation analysis with task-level comparisons against standard MLLM training. The credibility will depend on whether the setup cleanly isolates timing mismatch from generic optimization effects.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations include The Chinese University of Hong Kong and Shenzhen Loop Area Institute. No widely established marquee author can be confidently identified from the metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 多语 MLLM 掉点常被粗暴归因到数据，这篇至少给了一个可干预的时序机制；先看机制图和消融，若干预足够干净，值得在内部多模态对齐实验里复现。
recommendation.en: People often hand-wave multilingual MLLM failures as a data issue; this paper offers a timing-based mechanism you can actually intervene on. Read the mechanistic evidence and ablations first, and replicate only if the intervention is clean.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Affiliation:The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented vision-language models increasingly "think with images": they call crop, zoom, or code tools and reason over the returned pixels. However, recent work using blind tests, gain decompositions, and attention analyses has shown that returned images contribute little, raising the question: if pixels do not carry the gain, what does? We hypothesize that the load-bearing signal is the structured text emitted before any returned pixel arrives: tool name, coordinates, target description, a

summary.core_problem: 工具增强VLM在“看图思考”时，性能增益到底来自返回的像素，还是来自工具调用前生成的结构化文本脚手架？
summary.importance: 机制/归因分析：把一类常见的tool-use视觉推理增益拆解为“文本结构信号”，对多模态预训练与agent式交互数据的建模目标有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TextCall（call-but-no-return）对照：保留工具名/坐标/意图等调用文本，但将返回图像替换为占位符[Image output skipped]；在LoRA、全参微调与RL设置下比较“有无返回像素”的差异，并结合blind tests、gain decomposition、attention分析支撑归因。
summary.experiments: 在多种训练范式（LoRA/全参/RL）下，TextCall可匹配或超过完整“thinking-with-images”；并报告RL下保留工具使用行为、避免某些训练失败模式（摘要提到但未给具体数值/基准名）。

summary_en.core_problem: In tool-augmented VLM visual reasoning, does the gain come from returned pixels or from the structured textual scaffold emitted before any pixels arrive?
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic attribution result: it reframes a common 'think-with-images' tool-use gain as largely a text-structure effect, which matters for multimodal pretraining objectives and agent-style interaction data.
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose TextCall (call-but-no-return): keep tool name/coordinates/intent text but replace returned images with a placeholder. Validate via controlled comparisons across LoRA, full finetuning, and RL, plus blind tests, gain decomposition, and attention analyses.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple training regimes, TextCall matches or exceeds full tool-return pipelines; under RL it preserves tool-use behavior at the reported checkpoint and avoids a cited failure mode (details/benchmarks not in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把“工具返回像素”拆成“调用文本脚手架”后仍不掉点，这会直接影响你怎么做tool-use数据与多模态对齐；只看TextCall设定与RL那组对照就够。
recommendation.en: If performance holds with pixels removed but the call text kept, your tool-use/multimodal training signal is misattributed; read the TextCall control and the RL ablation.

paper.title: GraphVerse: A Comprehensive Visual Graph Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse vision-language tasks, creating an urgent need for more challenging benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations still provide limited insight into whether these models can truly reason over structured visual information. Visual Graph Reasoning (VGR) offers a compelling testbed for this challenge, requiring models to integrate perception, structural understanding, and multi-step reasoning over graph-based vi

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型评测无法充分衡量模型对结构化视觉图形的感知、结构理解与多步推理能力。
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，构建覆盖单图/双图场景、联合评估感知-视觉推理-文本图推理的统一评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 提出GraphVerse基准，以图为中心的图像生成与任务设计，避免将任务退化为纯感知加文本推理，引入更贴近真实场景的结构化图形推理任务。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未披露具体评测模型列表、数据集规模与各模型得分，仅给出基准设计框架。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM benchmarks fail to adequately evaluate structured visual graph reasoning that integrates perception, structural understanding, and multi-step inference.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution introducing a unified evaluation suite for visual graph reasoning across single-image and paired-image settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents GraphVerse, a graph-centric benchmark that jointly evaluates perception, visual reasoning, and text-based graph reasoning without reducing tasks to perception plus off-the-shelf text reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not report benchmark size, evaluated models, or quantitative scores; only the benchmark design is outlined.

recommendation.zh: 多模态结构化推理的细分评测，对预训练研究员价值有限，做VLM能力诊断时可参考其任务设计维度。
recommendation.en: A niche multimodal structured-reasoning benchmark; of limited value to pretraining researchers except as reference for VLM capability diagnosis.

paper.title: Aligning Large Vision-Language Models at Test Time: A Trajectory-Guided Structured Sampling Approach
paper.abstract: Post-training reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are commonly used to align large vision-language models (LVLMs) with human intent and the requirements of visual reasoning tasks. However, existing RL-based alignment methods are often resource-intensive and encounter mismatches between training objectives and inference-time distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel test-time alignment approach that leverages trajectory-guided structured sampling for dynamic inference-time refineme

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 后训练对齐成本高、训练目标与推理时分布不匹配的问题，尝试在测试时动态修正视觉推理轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态推理的 test-time alignment 方法，不需要重新进行 RL 后训练；对预训练研究的价值主要在于观察推理时结构先验如何替代部分训练时对齐信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先通过 trajectory learning 构建 reasoning memory bank，把复杂视觉问答分解为预定义推理模式序列；推理时从 memory bank 采样轨迹形成全局结构先验，再用迭代 MCMC 式结构化采样做动态 refinement，以改善视觉 grounding 和逻辑一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法在视觉 grounding 和逻辑一致性上优于常规 RL-based alignment 或直接推理方式，但给定信息未包含具体 LVLM backbone、模型参数量、benchmark 名称、提升幅度和推理成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 East China Normal University、Hasso Plattner Institute、University of Potsdam 和 City University of Hong Kong。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and train-test mismatch of LVLM alignment by dynamically refining visual reasoning trajectories at test time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time alignment method for multimodal reasoning, avoiding additional RL post-training. Its pretraining relevance is indirect: it probes how inference-time structural priors can substitute for some training-time alignment signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first builds a reasoning memory bank through trajectory learning, decomposing complex visual QA into ordered sequences of predefined reasoning patterns. At inference time, it samples trajectories from the bank to form a global structural prior, then applies iterative MCMC-style structured sampling for refinement to improve grounding and consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improvements in visual grounding and logical consistency over RL-based alignment or direct inference baselines, but the provided text does not specify LVLM backbones, parameter counts, benchmarks, effect sizes, or added inference cost.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with East China Normal University, Hasso Plattner Institute, University of Potsdam, and City University of Hong Kong.

recommendation.zh: 推理时对齐的想法可备查；重点看 MCMC 采样开销和 memory bank 构造，缺成本曲线就别信泛化收益。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as test-time alignment; inspect the MCMC cost and memory-bank construction, and distrust generalization claims without a cost curve.

paper.title: TraceViT: Grounded Trace Supervision for Visual Abstract Reasoning
paper.abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) tests whether a model can infer an unseen transformation from a few input-output examples and apply it to a new grid. Looped visual reasoners refine predictions over multiple iterations, but conventional training constrains only the final output, leaving intermediate refinements unconstrained. We propose that these refinements should instead follow the transformation step by step. We introduce TraceViT, a looped visual reasoner trained with semantically

summary.core_problem: 解决 ARC 视觉抽象推理中，循环式模型只监督最终答案、缺少中间推理轨迹约束的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是过程监督和视觉推理训练方法。它与 LLM 的 CoT/process supervision 有概念相似性，但实验对象是视觉网格推理，不应高估到通用语言预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TraceViT，一个 looped visual reasoner。作者将程序化 ARC 解法重写并验证为语义单调的 transformation chain，把每一步中间 grid state 作为监督信号；模型每轮迭代使用 few-shot demonstrations 派生的 task reference 和当前 grid 的 object workspace；soft trace alignment 只约束中间状态顺序，允许链长与循环步数不一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示 TraceViT 在 ARC 上达到 67 开头的结果，但原文片段被截断，无法确认完整指标、训练规模和 baseline 细节。可确认的是对比对象为常规只监督最终输出的 looped visual reasoners。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the lack of intermediate supervision in looped visual reasoners for ARC-style abstract reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a process-supervision method for visual reasoning. It is conceptually related to CoT and process supervision in LLMs, but the evidence is from grid-based visual reasoning rather than general language-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: TraceViT trains a looped visual reasoner with semantically monotonic transformation chains. The chains are obtained by rewriting and verifying programmatic task implementations into intermediate grid states. Each iteration is grounded by a task reference from few-shot demonstrations and an object workspace for the current grid. Soft trace alignment preserves ordering without forcing the number of trace steps to match the loop length.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract fragment reports a result beginning with 67 on ARC, but the exact metric and full number are truncated. The relevant baseline class is looped visual reasoners trained only with final-output supervision.

recommendation.zh: 读 trace alignment 设定即可；视觉 ARC 的过程监督信号有趣，但离通用 LM 训练还远。
recommendation.en: Skim the trace-alignment setup; the process-supervision signal is interesting, but the visual ARC setting is far from general LM training.

paper.title: Beacon: Knowing When and How to Perform Agentic Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: The fundamental goal of agentic visual reasoning is to improve the success rate of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on complex tasks, rather than merely equipping them with a sophisticated yet inefficient reasoning paradigm. In this work, we rethink agentic visual reasoning through two key dimensions of tool use: Mode Adaptiveness (MA) and Tool Effect (TE). Mode Adaptiveness characterizes whether an MLLM can recognize when tools are truly necessary and invoke them accordingly, thereby av

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 agentic visual reasoning 中“何时该用工具、用了工具是否真的带来净收益”这两个长期被忽略的问题。
summary.importance: 价值不在提出一个更复杂的视觉 agent，而在把工具使用拆成 Mode Adaptiveness 和 Tool Effect 两个可分析维度，属于对 MLLM agent 范式的诊断性研究。对预训练研究员的启发主要在于：工具使用并不天然提升能力，评估与训练目标需要区分“会不会用”和“该不该用”。
summary.technical_approach: 论文重新定义 agentic visual reasoning 的分析框架：MA 衡量模型是否能识别需要工具的样本并只在必要时调用，TE 衡量工具是否真正扩展了原模型能力而不是引入额外错误。作者据此对现有 MLLM agent 进行系统分析，并讨论何时、如何执行 agentic visual reasoning。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其核心是综合分析而非新模型训练，实验应覆盖多种 MLLM 与工具配置，量化 MA 与 TE 两项指标，并展示现有方法在不必要调用、收益不足或引入错误上的问题。若你关心的是训练 recipe，本工作更多提供评测与诊断视角，而非直接可复现的 pretrain 改动。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies two neglected questions in agentic visual reasoning: when tools should be used, and whether tool use actually yields net gains.
summary_en.importance: The value is not a more complicated visual agent, but a diagnostic decomposition of tool use into Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect. For pretraining researchers, the takeaway is that tool use is not automatically beneficial, and training/evaluation should separate 'can use tools' from 'should use tools'.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reframes agentic visual reasoning with two analysis axes: MA measures whether an MLLM invokes tools only when needed, and TE measures whether tools truly extend capability rather than adding errors. Existing MLLM agents are then systematically analyzed under this framework.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests a broad empirical analysis rather than a new training recipe, likely spanning multiple MLLMs and tool settings with quantitative MA/TE measurements. For pretraining work, this is more useful as an evaluation/diagnostic lens than as a directly actionable recipe.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它把“工具有用”拆成两个更干净的变量；只看指标定义和失败案例，能帮你避免把 agent 增益误判成模型能力增益。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly separates 'tool use helps' into two variables; read the metric definitions and failure cases to avoid mistaking agent gains for model gains.

paper.title: See2Think: Do Multimodal Models Really Use Intermediate Visual States?
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models increasingly use sketches, annotations, tools, and intermediate images during reasoning, but it remains unclear whether they truly rely on these visual states. Existing benchmarks are limited both by task collections with narrow coverage or partially text-solvable samples and by evaluations that emphasize final answers without diagnosing how intermediate visual states are generated, rendered, and used. We introduce See2Think, a unified evaluation framework compri

summary.core_problem: 评估多模态模型在推理时是否真的使用草图、标注、工具生成图像等中间视觉状态，而不是只在文本链路上得到最终答案。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个多模态推理评测框架。它把最终答案评估拆成视觉动作生成、渲染状态质量、后续推理使用情况等环节，能暴露常规 VLM benchmark 中被文本可解样本和只看 final answer 掩盖的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 See2ThinkBench 和 Visual Action-of-Thought。See2ThinkBench 含 1200 个开放式、视觉依赖问题，覆盖 12 类任务，包括 2D 结构、3D 场景和真实世界推理。VAoT 记录文本思考、视觉动作、渲染状态和后续推理，并在四种受控推理设置下比较模型行为。
summary.experiments: 评测了代表性的闭源和开源多模态模型。摘要强调主要发现是视觉推理效果强依赖模型和环境配置；现有模型并不稳定地利用中间视觉状态。具体模型名单、分项分数和提升幅度需看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether multimodal models actually use intermediate visual states such as sketches, annotations, tool outputs, and rendered images during reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation framework for multimodal reasoning. Instead of scoring only final answers, it decomposes the process into visual action generation, rendered-state quality, and downstream use of those states.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce See2ThinkBench and Visual Action-of-Thought. See2ThinkBench contains 1,200 open-ended visually dependent problems across 12 categories, spanning 2D structured reasoning, 3D scenes, and real-world reasoning. VAoT logs textual thoughts, visual actions, rendered states, and subsequent reasoning under four controlled inference settings.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates representative proprietary and open-source multimodal models. The abstract reports that visual reasoning is highly model- and environment-dependent, and that current systems do not reliably exploit intermediate visual states. Detailed model lists and scores require the main tables.

recommendation.zh: 读评测设计和错误分解即可；它能校准“画图推理”是否真在用视觉状态这个 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the evaluation design and error decomposition; it is useful for calibrating claims about visual-state reasoning.

paper.title: Be Consistent! Enhancing Robust Visual Reasoning in LVLMs with Consistency Constraints
paper.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong perceptual capabilities, they remain vulnerable in visual reasoning tasks. Existing benchmarks largely focus on symbolic mathematical or scientific problems and simple vision-centric tasks, offering limited assessment of complex visual reasoning and logical consistency, a critical requirement for reliable reasoning systems. We introduce ConVBench, a complex vision-centric reasoning benchmark in which each image is paired with two logicall

summary.core_problem: 评估并改进 LVLM 在复杂视觉推理中的逻辑一致性：模型可能答对单个问题，但对逻辑等价问题给出不一致答案。
summary.importance: 贡献包括一个视觉中心推理 benchmark、两个一致性相关指标，以及基于 GRPO 的一致性约束训练。它不是预训练工作，但对多模态后训练信号设计和评测协议有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ConVBench，每张图像配对两个逻辑等价问题，覆盖动作与状态、复杂计数、空间推理、因果与意图、常识推理、时间感知六类。评测上定义 logical consistency 和 robust accuracy；方法上提出 ConVLM，用 GRPO 强化学习把一致性约束纳入 LVLM 训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、训练样本规模、baseline 名单或具体提升幅度。实验应围绕 ConVBench 上不同 LVLM 的正确率、一致性和 robust accuracy 展开，并比较 GRPO 一致性训练前后表现。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Texas at Dallas 和 Amazon Web Services。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and improves logical consistency in LVLM visual reasoning, where a model may answer one question correctly but fail on a logically equivalent counterpart.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a vision-centric reasoning benchmark, consistency-aware metrics, and a GRPO-based training method. It is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to multimodal post-training signal design and evaluation protocol design.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConVBench pairs each image with two logically equivalent questions across six categories: action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal and intent understanding, commonsense reasoning, and temporal perception. The paper defines logical consistency and robust accuracy, and introduces ConVLM, which applies GRPO with consistency constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. The experiments likely compare LVLMs on correctness, consistency, and robust accuracy, and measure the effect of GRPO-based consistency training.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Texas at Dallas and Amazon Web Services.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 构造和 robust accuracy 定义；GRPO 部分更像后训练套件，别过度外推到基座训练。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and robust-accuracy metric; the GRPO part is a post-training recipe and should not be over-generalized to base training.

paper.title: Trace: A Taxonomy-Guided Environment for Multidomain Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved language-model reasoning, yet its extension to vision-language models remains constrained by the lack of training data that are simultaneously broad, exactly verifiable, and reproducible. We introduce Trace, a taxonomy-guided environment for multidomain visual reasoning. Trace factorizes task construction into a scene grammar and an executable task program, separating visual realization from answer computation. A sh

summary.core_problem: VLM的RLVR训练缺乏覆盖范围广、标注精确可验证、可复现的视觉推理训练数据，限制了可验证奖励强化学习在VLM推理能力提升上的落地效果。
summary.importance: 提出了面向多域视觉推理的过程化任务生成框架，通过解耦视觉渲染和答案计算逻辑，自动生成带精确验证器的大规模视觉推理样本，为VLM的RLVR训练提供了可复现的开源环境。
summary.technical_approach: 将视觉推理任务构建分解为场景语法和可执行任务程序两部分，分离视觉渲染过程与答案计算逻辑；通过共享语义状态同步生成渲染图像、文本提示、标准答案、验证器状态与可复现的实例轨迹；支持跨11个视觉域、277种场景语法的可控生成，可系统性调节语义和视觉变化幅度。
summary.experiments: 在6.4万条Trace生成的样本上对Qwen2.5-VL-3B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B进行RLVR训练，模型在24个外部视觉推理benchmark上的宏平均准确率分别提升3.51、4.06个百分点，验证了广覆盖过程化训练的跨环境迁移能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Extending reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to vision-language models is bottlenecked by the lack of training data that is broad in coverage, exactly verifiable, and fully reproducible.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces a procedural multi-domain visual reasoning environment that decouples visual rendering from answer computation, enabling automatic generation of large-scale visual reasoning samples with precise verifiers, and provides a reproducible setup for VLM RLVR training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Task construction is factorized into a scene grammar module and an executable task program, separating visual realization from answer computation. A shared semantic state is used to jointly produce rendered images, text prompts, ground-truth answers, verifier states, and replayable instance traces. The environment spans 11 visual domains, 277 scene grammars, and 1000 tasks with controlled semantic and visual variation.
summary_en.experiments: RLVR training on 64,000 Trace instances improves macro-average accuracy across 24 external visual reasoning benchmarks by 3.51 points for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 4.06 points for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, demonstrating transfer from procedurally generated broad-coverage visual tasks to out-of-domain benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 将文本RLVR的程序化可验证数据生成思路迁移到视觉推理，无本质方法创新，了解迁移效果即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Transfers procedural verifiable data generation from textual RLVR to visual reasoning without fundamental novelty; knowing the transfer result is sufficient, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Constraint-Anchored Reasoning Traces
paper.abstract: Autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) suffer from error snowballing: a single incorrect inference early in a chainof-thought (CoT) trace corrupts all downstream reasoning. We find that in state-of-the-art open-source MLLMs, once the first error occurs, the reasoning cascades into failure across all remaining steps in 65% of such cases (a metric we term the snowball rate). Existing mitigations-sampling multiple chains, post-hoc self-verification, or full program synthesis-either

summary.core_problem: 自回归MLLM的CoT推理存在错误滚雪球效应，首个推理步骤出错后会沿生成链传播，导致后续全链失效，现有缓解方法存在符号接地缺失、纠错滞后、损失自然语言灵活性等问题。
summary.importance: 首次量化了开源SOTA MLLM的CoT错误滚雪球概率，提出的神经符号锚定思路为多模态推理轨迹设计提供了参考，但整体方法属于现有神经符号推理框架的增量改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CART（Constraint-Anchored Reasoning Traces）框架：训练MLLM在自然语言CoT步骤中穿插插入可机器检查的轻量符号约束断言（如视觉物体计数、属性判断），设计双路约束传播模块，结合神经接地头将符号断言对齐到视觉特征，通过布尔约束传播实时校验一致性，提前阻断错误传播。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体测试模型、参数量、基线对比结果，仅报告开源SOTA MLLM的首步错误会导致65%的案例全链失败，框架可实现约束实时校验（摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: Autoregressive MLLMs suffer from error snowballing in CoT reasoning: an error in the first reasoning step propagates along the generation chain and corrupts all subsequent steps; existing mitigations lack symbolic grounding, catch errors too late, or sacrifice natural language reasoning flexibility.
summary_en.importance: First quantifies the CoT error snowball probability of state-of-the-art open-source MLLMs; the proposed neuro-symbolic anchoring idea provides reference for multimodal reasoning trace design, though the overall method is an incremental improvement over existing neuro-symbolic reasoning frameworks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CART (Constraint-Anchored Reasoning Traces): trains MLLMs to interleave natural language CoT steps with lightweight, machine-checkable symbolic constraint assertions (e.g., visual object counts, attribute judgments); designs a dual-pronged constraint propagation module that combines a neural grounding head to align assertions with visual features and Boolean constraint propagation to check consistency in real time, blocking error propagation early.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific test models, parameter counts or baseline comparisons, only reports that first-step errors lead to full chain failure in 65% of cases for open-source SOTA MLLMs, and the framework enables real-time constraint checking (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: 量化了MLLM的CoT错误滚雪球率（65%）是唯一有价值的信号，神经符号锚定方法偏常规，对预训练无直接启发，记个数字即可。
recommendation.en: The only valuable signal is the quantified 65% CoT error snowball rate in MLLMs; the neuro-symbolic anchoring method is conventional with no direct pretraining implications; just note the number.

paper.title: An Exam for Active Observers
paper.abstract: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for ML

summary.core_problem: 提出一个评测多模态大模型是否具备主动观察能力的 benchmark，而不是只评测单张图像的静态描述或问答。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark。ActiveVision 把视觉理解从一次性 perception 扩展到闭环观察：模型需要根据中间假设反复查看图像区域。这个失败模式对 native multimodal 预训练有提示，但它本身不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: ActiveVision 包含 3 类共 17 个任务，任务设计要求模型进行多步视觉检查，并按访问顺序列出标注点。评测目标是把主动 gaze-like observation 从普通视觉问答中分离出来，使其成为可测量能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 frontier MLLMs 在 ActiveVision 上大幅失败：最高分模型 GPT-5.5 在最高 reasoning-effort 设置下只解出 10.6%，17 个任务中 11 个为零分；Claude Fable 5 只得 3.5%；3 名人类参与者平均 96.1%。这些数字主要说明 benchmark 对现有 MLLM 的分布外压力很强。
summary.authors_note: 来自 University of Southern California。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a benchmark for measuring whether multimodal LLMs can actively observe an image instead of answering from a single static view.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset. ActiveVision turns visual understanding into a closed-loop process where the model must repeatedly inspect regions based on intermediate hypotheses. This is relevant to native multimodal pretraining, but it is not itself a training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActiveVision contains 17 tasks across three categories. The tasks are designed to require repeated visual perception and ordered reporting of visited labeled points, separating active observation from ordinary image captioning or VQA.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports severe failures by frontier MLLMs: GPT-5.5 at the highest exposed reasoning-effort tier solves only 10.6% of items and scores zero on 11 of 17 tasks; Claude Fable 5 scores 3.5%; three human participants average 96.1%. The key result is a large human-model gap under closed-loop visual inspection.

recommendation.zh: 扫任务定义和失败案例即可；它指出 MLLM 的主动感知缺口，但暂时不给预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the task design and failure cases; it exposes an active-perception gap in MLLMs, but does not yet translate into a pretraining recipe.

institutions: and list the labelled points visited in order

paper.title: Hierarchical Denoising For Multi-Step Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Video models are evolving into vision foundation models, yet they still lack human-like multi-step reasoning. Streaming autoregressive diffusion models are efficient but limited in reasoning, while bidirectional diffusion enables global revision with high inference costs due to dense frame-level denoising. Both paradigms struggle to achieve logical consistency and low-latency streaming for complex reasoning tasks. We propose HDR (Hierarchical Denoising for Visual Reasoning), a unified framework

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型在“多步视觉推理”和“低延迟流式生成”之间存在张力：因果流式自回归扩散效率高但承诺过早、难以全局修订；双向扩散支持全局一致性但要对整段序列做密集去噪，推理成本高、不适合流式输出。
summary.importance: 对多模态生成建模和视频作为 world model 的研究有直接启发。论文抓住了一个很实际的矛盾：推理需要保留高层假设并反复修订，流式部署则要求局部因果、低延迟增量输出。HDR 尝试在二者之间引入显式的层次化中间规划空间，这与文本/多模态模型中“先规划后生成”“粗到细推理”的思路相通，也对视频 diffusion LM、具身世界模型、长轨迹一致性建模有参考意义。不过论文目前更像方法论文与推理 benchmark 结合，预训练层面的通用性与规模化证据还比较有限。
summary.technical_approach: HDR 在流式自回归扩散框架中引入树状层次 latent 结构，在真正逐帧流式输出前先做 coarse-to-fine 多层级推理。核心设计有两点。第一是 hierarchy-matched denoising schedule：不对所有层级做同等强度去噪，而是让更粗的层级保留更高噪声，以维持多个全局规划假设；更细的层级则接收更强去噪，把高层计划实例化为具体视觉状态。第二是 SHAP（Sparse Hierarchical Attention Pattern）：每个 token 只与局部上下文和父层级上下文通信，不做稠密的全时序/全层级注意力，从而在保留多尺度信息流的同时降低流式推理开销。整体上，它相当于在 causal streaming diffusion 里加了一个显式的“规划层/计划树”，让高层可以在不完全承诺像素级细节的情况下持续修订，再向下逐层细化。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了一个分层多步视频推理 benchmark，覆盖迷宫导航、汉诺塔、一笔画、滑块拼图、推箱子、倒水六类任务，并包含 OOD 情形。相比流式 AR diffusion 与双向 diffusion 基线，HDR 在最终任务成功率上整体从 34.22 提升到 60.29，相对提升 76.2%；平均进度分从 76.00 提升到 89.56。流式效率上，HDR 每个 latent 约 0.70 s，比双向扩散快 54.2 倍。数据效率方面，只用 2% 数据训练时，HDR 仍保留全数据设置下 82.9% 的成功率，而双向扩散仅保留 52.0%。论文还给出真实机器人迷宫实验，说明层次化推理能力可迁移到物理交互。需要注意这些结果主要来自受控推理任务，不是大规模开放域视频生成或通用多模态预训练评测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读引言、方法总览和实验表格，预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。重点看 Figure 1 对三种范式的对比，以及层级去噪调度和 SHAP 注意力模式的设计动机，不必一开始陷入实现细节。若关心视频 diffusion 推理机制，可重点关注“为什么粗层高噪声有助于保留多个规划假设”这一点；若关心工程部署，则看 SHAP 如何限制注意力连通域。后续值得追问的是：层次 latent 如何预训练得到、层级数和树结构如何选择、该机制能否扩展到开放域长视频和音视频联合建模，以及 coarse plan 的修订是否会破坏已输出帧的因果一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video generation models face a tension between multi-step visual reasoning and low-latency streaming: streaming autoregressive diffusion is efficient but commits too early and struggles with global revision, while bidirectional diffusion supports global consistency but requires dense denoising over fixed sequences, making it expensive and poorly suited to streaming deployment.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to multimodal generative modeling and video-as-world-model research. It identifies a practical trade-off: reasoning requires maintaining and revising high-level hypotheses, while streaming deployment demands local causal, low-latency incremental output. HDR inserts an explicit hierarchical intermediate planning space between these two regimes. This connects to broader ideas such as plan-then-generate and coarse-to-fine reasoning in language and multimodal models, and may inform video diffusion LMs, embodied world models, and long-horizon consistency modeling. That said, the evidence is currently limited to controlled reasoning tasks rather than large-scale open-domain pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: HDR integrates a tree-structured latent hierarchy into a streaming autoregressive diffusion process and performs coarse-to-fine reasoning before streaming output. There are two core designs. First, a hierarchy-matched denoising schedule: coarser layers are kept at higher noise levels so they can preserve multiple global plans, while finer layers receive stronger denoising to instantiate those plans into concrete visual states. Second, SHAP (Sparse Hierarchical Attention Pattern): each token communicates only with fixed local context and parent-level context, avoiding dense full-sequence or full-hierarchy attention while preserving multi-scale information flow. Conceptually, this adds an explicit planning tree inside causal streaming diffusion, allowing high-level decisions to be revised before they are fully committed to frame-level details.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces a level-stratified multi-step video reasoning benchmark with OOD settings across six tasks: maze navigation, Tower of Hanoi, one-line drawing, sliding puzzle, Sokoban, and water pouring. HDR improves overall task success score from 34.22 to 60.29, a 76.2% relative gain, and raises average progress score from 76.00 to 89.56. During streaming it achieves 0.70 s per latent, reported as 54.2× faster than bidirectional diffusion. In data-efficiency ablations, with only 2% training data HDR retains 82.9% of its full-data success score, compared with 52.0% for bidirectional diffusion. Real-world robot maze experiments suggest transfer to physical interaction. These results are from controlled reasoning environments rather than large-scale open-domain video or general multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, method overview, and result tables; estimated reading time 20–30 minutes. Focus on Figure 1 for the contrast between paradigms, and on the motivation behind the hierarchy-matched denoising schedule and SHAP attention pattern. Readers interested in diffusion-based reasoning should pay attention to why higher noise at coarse layers helps preserve multiple plans; readers interested in deployment should look at how SHAP constrains attention connectivity. Open questions worth tracking: how the hierarchical latents are pretrained, how tree depth and structure are chosen, whether the mechanism scales to open-domain long video and audio-visual modeling, and how revision at coarse levels interacts with causal consistency of already streamed frames.

recommendation.zh: 读架构和 attention pattern 即可；“层级 latent 做规划”方向对 latent reasoning 有用，但评测若靠视频观感会很脏。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and attention pattern; hierarchical latents for planning are relevant to latent reasoning, but video-quality-heavy evaluation can be noisy.

paper.title: UniVR: Thinking in Visual Space for Unified Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Learning broad world knowledge directly from raw visual data is a fundamental capability of intelligence. We introduce UniVR, the first investigation into simultaneously learning complex reasoning, fine-grained physical dynamics, and long-term planning from pure visual demonstrations. At its core, UniVR features VR-GRPO, a reinforcement learning paradigm with complementary global and step-level rewards. This approach enforces logical coherence and physical consistency throughout the reasoning pr

summary.core_problem: 探索模型能否仅从纯视觉 demonstrations 中学习复杂推理、物理动态和长程规划，而不依赖图文配对数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉推理训练范式和评测套件。它关心的是视觉空间中的 reasoning，而不是传统图像分类或检测；对 native multimodal pretraining 和 RL 后训练接口有弱相关启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniVR 及 VR-GRPO。VR-GRPO 使用全局奖励和 step-level 奖励的互补设计，分别约束最终逻辑一致性和中间过程的物理一致性，避免为每个任务手写规则或依赖 image-text pairs。论文还构建 VR-X，汇集 16 个来源，覆盖长程操作、空间谜题和物理推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 UniVR 在 VR-X 上最高提升 25%，并且纯视觉推理能力还能迁移提升若干多模态任务表现。未提供模型参数量、视觉数据规模、baseline 名称和各子任务细分结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether complex reasoning, physical dynamics, and long-horizon planning can be learned directly from pure visual demonstrations without image-text supervision.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a visual reasoning training paradigm plus a benchmark suite. It is relevant to native multimodal training because it treats visual sequences as a reasoning substrate rather than as inputs to be captioned first.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniVR introduces VR-GRPO, which combines global rewards with step-level rewards to enforce both final logical coherence and intermediate physical consistency. It avoids task-specific heuristics and image-text pairs. The paper also builds VR-X from 16 sources spanning long-horizon manipulation, spatial puzzles, and physical reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to a 25% improvement on VR-X and claims transfer benefits to several multimodal tasks. It does not specify model size, amount of visual demonstration data, baseline list, or detailed per-domain gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 VR-GRPO 奖励分解和 VR-X 任务组成；纯视觉 reasoning 的方向有意思，但摘要信息不足以信服。
recommendation.en: Read only the VR-GRPO reward decomposition and VR-X task mix; pure-visual reasoning is interesting, but the abstract is not enough to trust the claim.

paper.title: Beyond the Eye: Efficient Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Regulated Implicit Visual Tools
paper.abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made remarkable progress on fine-grained perception tasks under the "Thinking with Images" (TwI) paradigm by iteratively performing various visual tool operations. However, this paradigm relies heavily on frequent external tool calls and repeated image re-encoding, which leads to substantial computational overhead and inference latency. To address these issues, we propose Beyond the Eye (BEE), a novel implicit visual tool paradigm centered on

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多模态大模型Thinking with Images范式依赖频繁外部视觉工具调用、重复图像编码导致推理开销和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 多模态推理范式的效率改进，将显式工具调用内化到模型内部，属于MLLM后训练方法的增量创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出BEE隐式视觉工具范式，通过两阶段训练：1) 构造形式化思维链SFT数据，将视觉工具调用行为融入训练目标；2) 自调节训练，鼓励模型自适应平衡内部知识与隐式工具调用，避免冗余工具使用。
summary.experiments: 未给出具体模型参数量和数据集规模，仅说明在细粒度感知任务上显著降低推理延迟，同时保持性能。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the high computational overhead and latency in MLLM 'Thinking with Images' paradigms caused by frequent external visual tool calls and repeated image re-encoding.
summary_en.importance: Efficiency-oriented improvement of multimodal reasoning paradigm that internalizes explicit tool calls; incremental innovation in MLLM post-training methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BEE, an implicit visual tool paradigm with two-stage training: (1) formalized CoT SFT that encodes visual tool invocation behaviors into the training objective; (2) self-regulated training that adaptively balances internal knowledge and implicit tools to avoid redundant usage.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model size and dataset scale not provided; only claims significantly reduced inference latency while maintaining performance on fine-grained perception tasks.

recommendation.zh: MLLM工具调用内化的思路可参考，但实验细节不足，作为后训练范式的弱信号备查即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of internalizing tool calls in MLLMs is worth noting, but experimental details are insufficient; keep as a weak signal for post-training paradigm reference.

paper.title: OmniMapBench: Benchmarking Visual-Centric Reasoning on Diverse Map Documents
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in LVLMs necessitate robust benchmarks for complex, visually grounded reasoning. A critical limitation is identified in many document understanding benchmarks: visual content is often reducible to text, enabling high performance without genuine visual grounding. To address this limitation, OmniMapBench is introduced to foster visual-centric reasoning for map documents. The benchmark comprises 2,096 manually annotated question-answer pairs across 1,603 map documents from nine

summary.core_problem: 构建一个面向地图文档的 LVLM 视觉中心推理 benchmark，避免模型仅凭 OCR 文本或题目线索取得高分。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 评测资产和评测指标。它指出许多文档理解 benchmark 的视觉依赖不足，并用 Visual Dependency Index 量化图像不可替代性；对多模态预训练的评测设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: OmniMapBench 包含 1,603 份地图文档和 2,096 个手工标注问答，覆盖九类地图，并按感知、定位、关系理解、多步视觉推理等层级设计问题。论文提出 VDI：将图像替换为与问题无关的描述后，观察准确率下降幅度，以衡量任务对真实视觉内容的依赖。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明对多个 LVLM 进行了系统评估，并将 OmniMapBench 与已有 benchmark 的 VDI 比较，结果显示该 benchmark 的 VDI 更高，说明其视觉依赖更强；具体模型列表、分数和提升幅度未在摘要中完整给出。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory、Zhejiang University 和 Shanghai Innovation Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces a map-document benchmark for LVLMs that requires genuinely visual reasoning rather than relying on OCR text or question shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a VLM evaluation asset and a benchmark-level metric. It highlights that many document-understanding benchmarks are partially reducible to text and proposes Visual Dependency Index to quantify how much the image itself matters.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniMapBench contains 2,096 manually annotated QA pairs over 1,603 map documents from nine map categories. The tasks are organized by skill levels from perception to multi-step visual reasoning. The proposed VDI measures the accuracy drop when images are replaced by question-agnostic descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports comprehensive evaluation of multiple LVLMs and shows that OmniMapBench has higher VDI than established benchmarks, indicating stronger dependence on visual evidence. Exact model names, scores, and gaps are not fully specified in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Zhejiang University, and Shanghai Innovation Institute.

paper.title: On Locality and Length Generalization in Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: A striking feature of the human visual system is that it ingests visual information through a series of local foveated glimpses, rather than a single global computation. This makes human vision distinctly different from most popular computer vision models in use today, which input images globally and in a single shot. A natural question therefore is whether local, sequential vision models may provide any fundamental computational benefits in addition to being biologically more plausible than glo

summary.core_problem: 研究视觉推理模型在“长度外推”（训练只见短链路/少对象/低复杂度，测试要求更长依赖、更高分辨率或更多实体）时为何系统性失败，并定位失败是否来自“全局一次性看图”的感知方式，而不是单纯的模型容量或是否有递归结构。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大（更像视觉推理与泛化机制研究），但对“统一多模态预训练/视觉tokenizer + 推理”有一个明确启发：如果训练目标允许模型走捷径（全局注意力直接拟合统计相关性），OOD 长度外推会崩；而把信息获取过程显式化（局部、序列化的观测）能迫使模型学习可组合的算法式策略。这类结论会反过来影响两类预训练设计：1）VLM 是否需要显式的感知-行动式 tokenization/读图策略；2）长上下文/长链路推理评测不应只看语言侧，也要把“信息采集”纳入任务定义。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把语言模型里的 length generalization 诊断迁移到视觉：构造一组需要“分步读取局部证据并更新状态”的视觉状态跟踪任务（文中强调任务长度由最少推理步数定义，并可通过分辨率与实体数量共同控制）。核心对照是两条轴：
1）是否递归（recurrent vs 非递归/一次性前馈）；
2）是否局部感知（local glimpses 序列读取 vs global view 一次性输入）。
主要机制论断是：仅有递归不够——如果递归网络仍然看到全局图像，它仍会学到全局“感知捷径”，在更长任务上失效；必须同时满足“递归更新状态 + 严格局部观测”才更容易学到与长度无关的策略。论文还区分了 state tracking 类任务与 recall 类任务：后者更像记忆/检索，局部感知不但不必要，可能也不带来收益。另一个工程性但关键的点是：局部 glimpse 的大小与分辨率是泛化的敏感超参，过大容易泄露全局统计，过小则信息不足导致训练不稳或策略学不出来。

summary_en.core_problem: Diagnose why vision(-language) models that perform well in-distribution fail at length generalization—i.e., extrapolating to visually more complex instances that require more sequential reasoning steps—and test whether the root cause is global, one-shot perception rather than model scale or the mere presence of recurrence.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it offers a concrete lesson for foundation-model pretraining and multimodal unification: if the modeling interface allows global shortcuts, models can fit correlations that collapse under longer dependencies. Enforcing a sequential, local information-gathering interface can push models toward algorithmic, length-invariant strategies. This is relevant to (1) how we design visual tokenization/perception for native multimodal LMs, and (2) how we evaluate long-horizon reasoning—where “information acquisition” should be part of the task, not assumed away as in text-only setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds a visual testbed analogous to classic length-generalization tasks in LMs (e.g., parity), but where the model must actively aggregate spatially local evidence to track an underlying state. It varies difficulty along task length (minimum required steps) and image resolution/entity density. The key experimental factorization is a 2×2: recurrent vs non-recurrent computation, and local sequential glimpses vs global full-image input. The main claim is mechanistic: recurrence alone is insufficient—if a recurrent model still receives a global view, it can learn perceptual shortcuts that do not extrapolate. Robust OOD length generalization emerges when recurrence is paired with strictly local perception. The paper also separates state-tracking tasks from recall-style tasks, arguing locality is unnecessary (and not helpful) for the latter. A practical nuance is that glimpse size/resolution acts like an information bottleneck: too large leaks global cues; too small starves the model and destabilizes learning.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple synthetic tasks and one real-world task, the authors report: strong in-distribution performance for standard global-perception models but sharp degradation when extrapolating to longer instances; evidence that the failure is tied to global perception enabling shortcuts; substantial OOD gains when using recurrent models with strictly local glimpses; negative result for “recurrent + global input”; and sensitivity analyses showing glimpse size/resolution materially affects robustness. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main tables/figures with exact numbers (model sizes, train/test length ranges, absolute accuracies), so specific quantitative deltas cannot be stated reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the Introduction carefully for the causal thesis: why text-only length generalization misses the information-gathering component.
- Focus on the task construction section to understand how “length” is operationalized and how resolution interacts with entity density.
- Jump to the main result table/figure that lays out the 2×2 comparison (global vs local, recurrent vs non-recurrent) and the glimpse-size ablations—this is where the paper earns its point.
- If you work on VLM pretraining, map their “shortcut via global perception” to likely shortcut channels in patch-token pretraining (layout bias, co-occurrence, global pooling leakage) and consider whether objective/data constraints could emulate the same bottleneck without explicit glimpse policies.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是做 LLM，但它对“全局注意力天然更强”这个直觉有点泼冷水；只看任务设计和长度外推曲线，就够判断是否值得迁到文本侧。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it usefully pushes back on the intuition that global processing is automatically better; the task design and length-generalization curves are the parts to read.

paper.title: Scene Graph Thinking: Reinforcing Structured Visual Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong perception and reasoning capabilities. However, most existing models focus on isolated objects and neglect structured relationships for efficient target navigation, limiting their performance on visually intensive tasks. To address this challenge, we introduce Scene Graph Thinking (SaGe), a novel paradigm that enables fine-grained and structured visual reasoning through explicit scene-graph representations. Specifically, we first

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MLLM 在复杂视觉场景中缺少结构化关系建模的问题。现有“think-with-image”方法多依赖裁剪、放大和局部搜索，能改善局部感知，但容易把对象当成孤立实体处理，无法稳定利用对象、部件、属性、空间位置和交互关系之间的结构信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在基座训练 recipe，而在 VLM 后训练数据构造和奖励设计。它提供了一个可复用的思路：把平坦图文语料转换成显式场景图，再用图采样生成推理轨迹，使模型学习一种更可控的视觉推理中间表示。对 native multimodal pretraining 或 mid-training 也有启发：视觉数据不一定只以 caption、QA 或 dense caption 形式进入训练，可以先组织成层次化、关系化的表示，再映射成监督或强化学习信号。
summary.technical_approach: SaGe 的方法分两步。第一步是自动数据引擎，把图像和文本标注转换成层次化 scene graph。图中的节点表示对象、子实体或部件，并附带属性描述、bounding box、深度范围等信息；边表示空间关系、交互关系和语义关系。作者还设计了 sub-entity mining，把对象拆成更细粒度的层级节点，避免 scene graph 只停留在粗对象级别。第二步是基于图的训练数据生成与后训练。系统从图中采样节点和边，构造 node-centric 与 edge-centric QA；前者训练颜色、材质、状态、位置等细粒度属性，后者训练空间布局、交互、归属等关系判断。每条样本配有 node-articulated CoT，即在推理链中显式写出实体名、框坐标和深度线索。作者还沿图边做 traversal，合成多跳导航轨迹和综合场景描述。冷启动阶段使用 120K 结构化样本做监督训练；随后用 GRPO 做强化后训练，奖励包括 node-relevance reward 和 node-grounded reward，前者鼓励推理路径选中与问题语义相关的节点，后者鼓励引用实体的空间定位准确。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 SaGe 在 8 个视觉密集型 benchmark 上取得稳定提升，覆盖细粒度感知、关系推理和目标导航类能力。关键实验重点不是单一指标，而是结构化数据与图奖励是否能让模型更少依赖盲目裁剪搜索。给出的核心规模是 120K 高质量结构化训练样本。根据方法设计，最应关注的消融包括：去掉 scene graph 结构、去掉 sub-entity 层级、只用节点 QA 或只用边 QA、去掉 node-articulated CoT、只做 SFT 不做 GRPO、分别移除 node-relevance 与 node-grounded reward。摘要和引言中未给出具体分数表，精确提升幅度需要看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Introduction，理解它与裁剪/放大式视觉推理方法的区别。然后看数据引擎部分，重点关注节点如何层次化、边如何分类、bbox 与 depth cue 如何进入文本监督。方法部分最有信息量的是 graph sampling、graph traversal 和 node-articulated CoT 的构造方式。强化学习部分建议看 reward 定义，而不是只看 GRPO 名称；真正的设计点在于把 scene graph 节点作为 reward proxy。实验部分优先看消融表和错误案例，判断增益来自结构化表示、数据量，还是来自额外推理链格式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete weakness of current MLLMs: they can zoom into local regions, but they often lack an explicit representation of objects, parts, attributes, spatial layout, and relations. This makes fine-grained visual reasoning inefficient and brittle in cluttered scenes.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is in multimodal post-training data design rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is to turn flat image-text corpora into structured scene graphs, then sample supervision and RL signals from that structure. This points to a broader direction for VLM training: visual supervision can be organized as hierarchical and relational evidence, not only as captions, QA pairs, or cropped-region prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: SaGe builds an automated pipeline that converts image-text examples into hierarchical scene graphs. Nodes represent objects, sub-entities, or parts, enriched with attributes, bounding boxes, and estimated depth ranges. Edges encode spatial, interaction, and semantic relations. A sub-entity mining step increases granularity, so the graph is not limited to coarse object nodes. The training data is then produced by LLM-guided graph sampling and traversal. Node-centric samples ask about attributes such as color, material, state, and location; edge-centric samples ask about relations such as spatial layout, interaction, and ownership. The reasoning traces are node-articulated: entity names, coordinates, and depth cues are explicitly written as evidence. The first stage uses 120K structured examples for cold-start supervised training. The second stage applies GRPO with two node-based rewards: a node-relevance reward for selecting semantically appropriate graph nodes, and a node-grounded reward for accurate localization of referenced entities.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains on eight visually intensive benchmarks, especially for fine-grained perception, relational reasoning, and navigation-like visual reasoning. The central data scale is 120K structured training examples. The most informative experimental checks are the ablations: removing the scene graph, removing hierarchical sub-entities, comparing node-only and edge-only supervision, dropping node-articulated CoT, using SFT without GRPO, and separately disabling the node-relevance or node-grounded reward. Exact score deltas are not visible in the provided text and should be read from the result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand why crop-and-zoom reasoning is insufficient. Then read the data engine section carefully: node hierarchy, edge taxonomy, bounding boxes, and depth cues are the important details. In the training section, focus on graph sampling, graph traversal, and the construction of node-articulated reasoning traces. For the RL part, read the reward definitions rather than the GRPO wrapper. In the experiments, prioritize ablations and qualitative failures; they reveal whether the gains come from structure, data volume, or simply the imposed reasoning format.

recommendation.zh: “视觉版显式CoT”思路值得一看，重点看数据引擎怎么从图文造scene-graph轨迹；RL剪枝部分像常规后训练技巧，跳过不影响判断
recommendation.en: Interesting take on explicit visual CoT via scene graphs; focus on the data-engine section that synthesizes graph traces from image-text pairs; the RL pruning stage is standard post-training, skimmable.

summary_en.importance: Contributes a controlled UML benchmark that quantifies prior bias in VLMs by pairing prior-conforming diagrams with prior-conflicting counterparts that only reverse the relation arrow.

A promising solution is to pair a small draft model with a large target model, enabling cooperative inference employing a routing signal that adaptively routes queries to either the draft or target model based on their difficulties for optimal efficiency and accuracy. Yet, the remaining bottleneck is to establish a reliable query difficulty

summary.core_problem: 在多模态视觉推理中，如何在不依赖“生成完长 CoT 后再看 token 概率”的滞后信号、也不依赖对采样分布敏感的 SFT 特殊 token 方案的前提下，提前判断样本难度并进行 draft/target 模型路由，从而降低推理成本。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率与路由策略，不是预训练主线。对预训练研究的间接启发在于：它把“难度/可解性”建模成可学习的评分头，并用 RL（GRPO）训练在生成前给出可用信号；这种“前置评分信号”如果迁移到 pretrain/posttrain 接口上，可能用于数据课程、动态采样或训练时的 compute routing（例如 MoE/early-exit 的数据侧信号）。但论文的核心贡献仍在推理阶段系统设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Proactive Routing Paradigm (PRP)：在生成开始前就做路由。
